name: hover-video-preview
title: Hover video preview
description: A video thumbnail that plays a muted preview after you rest on it, and loads nothing until you do; skipped on touch, Save-Data and reduced motion.
docs: poster is the still and previewSrc a short muted clip. Nothing is requested before the pointer or keyboard focus has rested on the tile for delay milliseconds (300): the video element is not even on the page until then, and when you leave it stops and rewinds. The preview is skipped on touch screens, when the browser asks to save data and under reduced motion, where the poster simply stays. The whole tile is one link (href) or one button (onClick), named by its title and length; the video is decoration. duration is seconds or text.
